sources.forwardPeNote: Trailing PE is cap-weighted Σ(w·P)/Σ(w·trailingEps) computed from the 500 constituents daily, seeded with a long-run monthly series back to 1871. Forward PE is terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus estimates back to June 1990, published as one point per week (the last reading of each week). Alongside it we publish a second forward series computed daily from consensus estimates and published ETF holdings. The two are never blended: different estimate vintage, different weighting, different cadence. They agree to within 3%, and where they do not, the gap is the measurement and not an error to be smoothed away.
